Trigger: Rename, type, unit or enum changes
Expected evidence: Keep identity for rename; quarantine incompatible semantics and affected commands.

Trigger: Repeated native ID across sites/tenants
Expected evidence: No cross-tenant joins, disclosure or wrong acknowledgement.

Trigger: Alarm returns normal before acknowledgement
Expected evidence: Active becomes false; acknowledgement can remain pending; incident stays independent.

Trigger: Alarm recurs while an old ACK is pending
Expected evidence: Old receipt cannot acknowledge the new occurrence; refresh and show conflict.

Trigger: Panel direct feed and BMS mirror replay100 times
Expected evidence: One physical lineage; no duplicated incident, dispatch or broadcast.

Trigger: Lost cursor; paged snapshot with concurrent events
Expected evidence: Record gaps; do not clear alarms based on absence from a single page.

Trigger: Higher-priority local override
Expected evidence: Show rejected request or accepted non-winning demand accurately; no override bypass.

Trigger: Receipt lost after possible command execution
Expected evidence: Mark unknown; reconcile without blind resending.

Trigger: Lease expires and slot owner changes during restart
Expected evidence: Do not clear another owner; approved relinquishment requires readback.

Trigger: Fan demand accepted but proof false or bad
Expected evidence: No physical success; show demand/feedback discrepancy.

Trigger: Link loss, full buffer and two-node failover
Expected evidence: Local protection independent; durable commit and single-writer fencing hold.

Trigger: Alarm burst overlaps historian backfill
Expected evidence: Alarm queue remains available and upstream budgets are respected.

Trigger: Expired/revoked certificate or wrong tenant
Expected evidence: Privileged operations fail closed; no insecure fallback.

Trigger: Published incident is reflected by BMS
Expected evidence: No recursive incident creation; preserve exact receipt evidence.

Trigger: Maintenance ends before restoration
Expected evidence: Restoration remains pending and escalates; do not mark ready.

Trigger: Stale door/fan evidence affects route
Expected evidence: Re-evaluate or withdraw route and old speech; assistance remains accessible.

Trigger: AI-derived point, occupancy count or old badge event
Expected evidence: Do not present inference as measurement or confirmed occupant safety.

Trigger: VI/EN/JA, keyboard, zoom and color deficiency
Expected evidence: Critical action/source owner readable; raw identifiers remain unchanged.

Trigger: Exercise data reconnects after outage
Expected evidence: No exercise leak to actual operations; backfill cannot actuate.

Trigger: Retirement with open commands and leases
Expected evidence: Handover, revoke, verify and retain audit; no orphan remote override.

Trigger: Read-only enforcement — Attempt writes and external ACK with read-only identity
Expected evidence: Reject before dispatch; no native write audit entry.

Trigger: Scaling — Known pressure raw600 with scale100 and invalid unit
Expected evidence: Decode6.0bar; unapproved mapping never enters rules.

Trigger: Register addressing — Zero/one-based addresses and alternate32-bit word order
Expected evidence: Match golden fixtures; mismatches block commissioning.

Trigger: COV expiry — Subscription expiry or BMS restart
Expected evidence: Renew and reconcile; report stale during gap.

Trigger: MS/TP contention — Authorized burst on a constrained bus
Expected evidence: No polling storm; record actual latency and critical-event handling.

Trigger: Existing active alarms — Connect after alarms are already active
Expected evidence: Load current conditions; stay syncing until reconciled.

Trigger: Refresh race — New event arrives between refresh boundaries
Expected evidence: Older refresh data cannot overwrite new state.

Trigger: Duplicate delivery — Repeat identical source event
Expected evidence: One canonical transition; multiple receipts retained.

Trigger: Dual paths — Direct panel and BMS relay same alarm
Expected evidence: Link physical lineage; preserve both paths.

Trigger: Similar unrelated alarms — Equal labels and near timestamps on different devices
Expected evidence: No false merge based only on text/time.

Trigger: Late acknowledgement — Occurrence2 starts before ACK1 receipt
Expected evidence: ACK1 never clears ACK2 responsibility.

Trigger: Internal acknowledgement — SmartAlarm operator accepts work
Expected evidence: Native BMS acknowledgement remains unchanged.

Trigger: Return to normal — Source normal while rescue is unresolved
Expected evidence: Incident and occupant safety remain independent.

Trigger: Dispatch timeout — Controller might have acted but receipt is lost
Expected evidence: Unknown outcome and reconciliation; no blind retry.

Trigger: Expired offline command — Reconnect after command expiry
Expected evidence: Do not replay; require a new authorized intent.

Trigger: Local override — Operator obtains higher priority
Expected evidence: Do not report physical success; show ownership conflict.

Trigger: Lost writer — Kill edge between dispatch and receipt persistence
Expected evidence: Fence standby and reconcile before writes resume.

Trigger: Retained priority slot — Power loss while edge holds a BACnet priority
Expected evidence: Measure controller behavior; require accepted local fallback.

Trigger: Same-slot collision — Another application writes the same priority
Expected evidence: Do not assume ownership or clear with NULL automatically.

Trigger: Certificate rotation — Expired, changed or revoked trust material
Expected evidence: Fail closed for privileged actions; no automatic trust.

Trigger: Quality loss — Bad/uncertain point or missing source time
Expected evidence: No false normal/safe display; propagate uncertainty.

Trigger: Clock drift — Source clock skew and late delivery
Expected evidence: Keep both timestamps; do not overwrite newer occurrence.

Trigger: Alarm flood — Alarm burst plus ordinary telemetry
Expected evidence: Preserve transitions; only approved telemetry may coalesce.

Trigger: Disk capacity — Journal near/full capacity
Expected evidence: Actionable degradation and explicit gaps; no silent discard.

Trigger: Reflection loop — Summary sent out and reflected back
Expected evidence: Preserve origin; no new incident or command loop.

Trigger: Translation — VI/EN/JA status and action terminology
Expected evidence: Same operational meaning; preserve native codes.

Trigger: Isolation — Cross-tenant credential, mapping or command
Expected evidence: Reject and audit without topology or health-data disclosure.

Trigger: Emergency independence — Cloud and edge both unavailable
Expected evidence: Local protection remains independent under its own accepted design.
